component.name: Genies
component.summary: Chat with AI agents that each have a sandboxed Linux desktop of their own

description.p: Genies is a chat app whose every conversation partner is an AI agent, a genie. Each genie lives in a lamp: a rootless podman container with a Linux desktop, where it can install programs, run them and look at its own screen, without reaching your files.
Genies needs podman on this computer.
